summary.text: Amber Arlint is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 12 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

A former insurance agency owner with a doctorate in adult and higher education, she faces Democrat Stephanie Arne and Republican Kerry Loudenslager for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Amber Arlint earned a B.S. in political science in 2009, an M.A. in adult and higher education in 2014 and an Ed.D. in adult and higher education in 2018, all from the University of South Dakota, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes owning a State Farm Insurance agency, working as a distributor sales representative with Western Refining and serving as director of sorority/fraternity life and leadership at the University of South Dakota.
Arlint took office on January 10, 2023, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists her on the House Education, Retirement Laws and Transportation committees.
